// Why WhatsApp — and why IPS was first

Before WhatsApp quotes were standard practice in the Cape Town panel beating industry, International Panel Shop was already doing it. When Lance and Serena started sending quotes back over WhatsApp rather than requiring customers to drive in and wait, it was a genuine operational departure from how the industry worked. Customers who tried it the first time were often surprised — not at receiving a rough ballpark figure, but at receiving a real, usable quote from a photo on their phone.

Other panel shops have since adopted the same approach. IPS will tell you that plainly — and they consider it a good thing for Cape Town customers overall. But the dedicated quoting infrastructure that IPS built around the process is what separates a genuine WhatsApp quote service from a shop that occasionally replies to photo messages when someone is free.

The dedicated quoting team: WhatsApp quotes at IPS are handled by a team whose sole focus is responding to incoming quote requests — not a workshop technician replying between jobs. That distinction is why quotes come back the same day, why they are accurate rather than approximate, and why the process works the same whether you send your message at 8am on a Monday or 4pm on a Friday.

How to get your quote — five steps

// The exact process from photo to quote
01
Photograph the damage clearly
Take photos in good natural light. One wide shot showing the full panel, one close-up of the worst point. For rust, include the edges and any bubbling paint nearby. For accident damage, photograph from the front and side. You do not need to know what anything is called — just show what you can see.
02
WhatsApp the correct branch
Goodwood and southern Cape Town: 071 687 1308. Milnerton and northern suburbs: 065 741 7593. Either number works for a quote — use whichever branch is more convenient for drop-off later. Both lines go directly to the dedicated quoting team.
03
Include your vehicle make, model and year
Parts pricing varies significantly between vehicles. Knowing the make, model and year allows IPS to quote accurately from the photo alone, without needing to inspect the car first for most standard repairs.
04
State private pay or insurance
Tell them upfront whether you are paying privately or going through an insurance claim. Both are handled the same way — the quote process does not change. The output differs: private quotes are confirmed over WhatsApp; insurance claims get a formal Zoho PDF.
05
Receive a real quote — same day
The quoting team responds with a real, itemised quote. For insurance claims, IPS generates a professional PDF through Zoho — properly formatted for direct submission to your insurer or assessor. You are not forwarding a WhatsApp chat log as proof of cost.

Insurance claims — the Zoho PDF advantage

// What your insurer actually needs

When an accident is an insurance claim, the WhatsApp conversation is not what you submit to your insurer. What you need is a professionally formatted quote document — itemised, on letterhead, with the workshop's contact details, dated, and structured the way assessors expect to receive it.

IPS generates this through Zoho. Once the WhatsApp quote is confirmed, the quoting team produces a PDF that is ready to go directly to your insurer or assessor. You do not need to screenshot a conversation, forward a voice note, or explain to an assessor what "ok so basically the front panel costs about R4k" means in formal terms. The document does what a document needs to do.

Second opinions on write-offs: If your insurer has told you the vehicle is a write-off, get a WhatsApp quote from IPS before accepting that assessment. IPS has repaired vehicles that were marked for write-off by reducing costs through structural repair rather than replacement — bringing the total under the write-off threshold. It does not work every time, but it works often enough that the WhatsApp message is worth sending before signing anything.

Everything else IPS offers — full service list

// Beyond the quote

The WhatsApp quote is the entry point. Here is everything that sits behind it once you book — the full scope of what International Panel Shop does for Cape Town vehicle owners and fleet operators.

Mobicred — repairs on credit

If you hold a Mobicred account, you can pay for your repair through flexible monthly instalments rather than a single upfront payment. Accidents are unplanned — the cost should not have to hit at once. Select Mobicred via the PayFast secure payment link when approving your quote.

Free vehicle collection — repairs above R10,000

For all accepted repairs valued at R10,000 and above, IPS arranges an Uber to collect your vehicle from your location. Once repaired, the vehicle is delivered back to your door. No second trip to Goodwood required.

Right to Repair certified

IPS is accredited under the Right to Repair programme. Repairs at IPS do not void your vehicle's manufacturer warranty — regardless of what a dealership service centre may suggest.

All vehicle brands including new Asian models

Toyota, Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Ford, Nissan, Suzuki — and all new Chinese and Asian brands entering South Africa including Chery, Haval, BYD, GWM, BAIC, Mahindra, and MG Motors. IPS works on all of them.

Fleet clients across the Western Cape

Getwine, Sunshine Co., French Market, Garsons Expeditions, Rolling Rentals, Real Africa Travel Tours, Two Oceans Road Side Assistance, Top Carpets and Floors — commercial operators who trust IPS with their vehicle fleets.
